# Oliver Eichhof

> Oliver Eichhof is a communication specialist from Hamburg, Germany, focused on digital brand management and audience analysis. This is his personal website, available in German, English and Danish.

The about pages below are maintained as machine-readable grounding pages with Person JSON-LD and serve as the verifiable source of facts about Oliver Eichhof.
